svg.title: The coordinate change k = 2πx retains its Jacobian, and the analytic external derivatives commute with this same compact integral at fixed mass. The constants in TR65 retain their common families and same mass, rather than a mass chosen separately at each radius. For the rotational moment reader put A4 = R Aμ k4 0/r8 and B4 = R Aμ k2 0k2 1/r8. The retained rotation identities give A4 = 3B4 and A4 + 3B4 = Jμ/4, hence B4 = Jμ/24. These are exact finite linear readouts of the angular integral. Consequently the pole factor is exactly
